premise: Fox's big bouncy steps keep waking everyone at nap time; Deer shows him slow hooves, Mouse shows him whisper-paws, and Fox tiptoes so well he surprises himself.
inspiration: The loud one taught by the quiet ones (folk elephant-and-mouse motif), turned: Fox is shown, not scolded, and gets to be proud of quiet.
lesson: Being gentle is something you can learn, and be proud of.

en-US.title: Fox Learns to Tiptoe
en-US.text: It was nap time in the forest. Everyone was asleep — except Fox. {fox:pulse} Fox did not walk. Fox BOUNCED. {fox:hop x3} {sfx:thump} Thump! Thump! Thump! The flower {flower:wobble} woke up. Mouse {mouse:wobble} woke up. Deer opened one eye. Fox, said Deer, {deer:pulse} come here. Watch my hooves. He lifted one hoof, slowly, and set it down like a feather. [whispers] Slow… and soft… Fox tried. {fox:hop} Thump. Slower, said Deer. Mouse {mouse:hop} tiptoed up. Watch my paws, he whispered. Whisper steps. Fox tried again. {fox:wobble} He lifted one paw. He set it down. {sfx:tiptoe solo} Nothing. Not a sound. [surprised] Fox looked at his own feet. Did I do that? he whispered. You did, whispered Mouse. Fox tiptoed all the way round the meadow, {fox:sparkle} quiet as a cloud, {fox:hearts} and everybody stayed asleep. [happily] Then he sat down very softly, and was so proud he could hardly keep it in. But he did.

es-ES.title: Zorro aprende a ir de puntillas
es-ES.text: Era la hora de la siesta en el bosque. Todos dormían, menos Zorro. {fox:pulse} Zorro no andaba. Zorro BOTABA. {fox:hop x3} {sfx:thump} ¡Pum! ¡Pum! ¡Pum! La flor {flower:wobble} se despertó. Ratón {mouse:wobble} se despertó. Ciervo abrió un ojo. Zorro, dijo Ciervo, {deer:pulse} ven. Mira mis pezuñas. Levantó una, despacio, y la posó como una pluma. [whispers] Despacio… y suave… Zorro lo intentó. {fox:hop} Pum. Más despacio, dijo Ciervo. Ratón {mouse:hop} se acercó de puntillas. Mira mis patitas, susurró. Pasos de susurro. Zorro lo intentó otra vez. {fox:wobble} Levantó una pata. La posó. {sfx:tiptoe solo} Nada. Ni un ruidito. [surprised] Zorro se miró los pies. ¿Eso lo he hecho yo?, susurró. Sí, susurró Ratón. Zorro dio la vuelta entera al prado de puntillas, {fox:sparkle} silencioso como una nube, {fox:hearts} y todos siguieron durmiendo. [happily] Luego se sentó muy suavecito, tan orgulloso que casi no podía aguantarse. Pero se aguantó.

thump.prompt: three bouncy thumps of paws landing on soft forest ground, playful and heavy

tiptoe.prompt: almost-silent tiptoe steps on moss, the faintest soft pads, then stillness
